content.comment_body: I am using a [product_name] PLC and have registered it to AWS Cloud, successfully transferring data from the PLC to the cloud. Now I'm attempting to create a custom website using [product_name] Web Editor, but I am unable to register my IoT device in the editor. I’ve attached the error below. If anyone has a solution, please reply.
Could you please check the environment status in the AWS Beanstalk console? Also, have you assigned the necessary Beanstalk policy to the account used for uploading the web project?
Hi, could you provide more details about these two issues, please?

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports difficulty integrating their [product_name] PLC with AWS Cloud using the [product_name] Web Editor, specifically in registering an IoT device through the web editor. The PLC successfully connects to AWS for data transfer, but cloud-based configuration or website deployment via the web editor fails. This indicates a disconnect between device-to-cloud communication and cloud-based web project setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward registration process for their IoT device within the [product_name] Web Editor to facilitate cloud-based website creation, matching the reliable PLC-to-AWS data transfer already achieved.
